title: Verify: MaxRetries exhaustion removes the worktree once unit tests
summary: Unit test for retry exhaustion cleanup
description: Add a test with MaxRetries 2 and three failing calls asserting attempts, FAILED status and one worktree removal.
acceptance_criteria: agent.calls is 3 and stored status FAILED with last error text
trees.removed has exactly one entry equal to WorkRoot/EXEC-1

steps.action: Use agent := &fakeAgent{errs: []error{errors.New("e1"), errors.New("e2"), errors.New("e3")}} and newRunner(t, Config{MaxRetries: 2, Timeout: 5 * time.Second}, agent); call Run("EXEC-1","ROUND-0000001"); assert err != nil, agent.calls == 3, stored Status == store.StatusFailed, stored Error contains "e3", and h.trees.removed equals []string{filepath.Join(h.cfg.WorkRoot, "EXEC-1")}.
